newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain has more easing scope - gov't spox.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain has more easing scope - gov't spox.

text.p: The Bank of Spain has more scope to ease if positive economic trends are maintained, said government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez on Friday.
"If the economy continues on as it has then there is scope for a further reduction which could take place in coming months," Rodriguez told journalists following a cabinet meeting.
Rodriguez added that with the February inflation data as announced on Thursday, Spain now adheres to the inflation pre-requisite for monetary union.
"At this time for the first time the inflation data meets the requirement for monetary union," Rodriguez said.
February CPI fell 0.1 percent from January for a 2.5 percent year on year rise, versus 2.9 percent a month earlier.
